title: W1 'fix' inert in production: review submit still reports focus_seconds 0 — the new field is never filled by client JS
evidence: form_pages.gleam: "attribute.type_("hidden"), attribute.name("_focus_seconds"), attribute.value("0"), attribute("data-focus-seconds", "")," — reference_form.js: "var page = doc.querySelector("[data-testid='reference-form-page']"); if (!page) return;" and "var section = form.closest(".ref-question"); if (!section) return;" (before "if (focusField) focusField.value = currentFocusSeconds();")
detail: Review page root is 'reference-review', so initBrowser bails at line 71; where wired, onSubmit returns at line 153 before filling the field. Real browsers submit _focus_seconds=0; only crafted POSTs reach 240. Production gap unchanged since r1.
recommended_fix: Wire the review form in reference_form.js: a document-level submit listener that sets any [data-focus-seconds] field before the native POST, independent of .ref-question; add a JS wiring test (existing node --test seam).
